search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Windows/OS/Windows "Win32_PerfFormattedData_PerfProc_Process" "_Total" "IOWriteBytesPersec" 
| parse regex "winbox = (?<dest_host>\S+)" nodrop 
| if (isNull(dest_host) or dest_host="",_sourceHost,dest_host) as host
| kv regex "= (?:\"|)(.*?)(?:\"|);" keys "IOWriteBytesPersec","Name" as ioWriteBytes,procName | where procName = "_Total"
| timeslice 1m 
| avg(ioWriteBytes) as AvgIOWriteBytes by host, _timeslice | sort - _timeslice | int(AvgIOWriteBytes/(1025*1024)) as AvgIOWriteMBytes | fields - AvgIOWriteBytes
| transpose row _timeslice column host
